description: Generate skeleton files for a new feature following the project's existing conventions -- controller, service, repository, DTOs, tests. Use when someone says "scaffold a new feature", "start a new feature", "set up the files for this", "generate the boilerplate", or "create the skeleton for X", so the file layout matches the codebase instead of guessing a framework default. Produces files only -- no plan, no rollout strategy, no sequencing of work. For deciding what to build and in what order before any files exist, use plan-change instead.
